title: Generate error audit CSV + FN/FP summary for user review
description: Run dump tool on test manifest → reports/damage_error_audit.csv (120 rows, expect 8 FN + 8 FP). Write reports/damage_error_audit_summary.md grouping errors by filename for inspection. acceptance_criteria: FN count == 8, FP count == 8 (matches baseline confusion)
summary.md lists every FN and FP filename for review
validation: ./.venv/bin/python -c "import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('reports/damage_error_audit.csv'); assert len(df)==120; assert (df.error_type=='FN').sum()==8 and (df.error_type=='FP').sum()==8"
